title: Live files
summary: The Code panel next to the conversation shows each file the request changes, with its diff as the agent writes, and the git status of each repository in the chat's folder.
usage: Click Code in the chat header, or use Ctrl+K. The panel opens by itself on the first change. Files lists the changed files, newest first; follow the agent to see each one as it changes. Repositories shows each repository's branch, how far it is ahead of or behind the remote, and how many files changed. If git can't read a repository, the line says why and, when it helps, gives the command to fix it. Without this feature in your plan, the panel only has Repositories.
